import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class IO {
        private static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        private static StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer("");
        public static int ReadInt() throws IOException {
            while (!st.hasMoreTokens()) st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }
        public static void WriteLong(long x) {
            System.out.print(x);
        }
    }

    static final long Mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long Mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static long answer = 0;
    static long n_value;
    static long Count1 = 0;
    static long Count2 = 0;
    static long[] power_ten = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static long[] total_sum = new long[7];
    static List<Long>[] values = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            values[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate_values(int level, long prefix) {
        if (level == 7) return;
        long val = (Count1 - prefix + Mod1) % Mod1;
        values[level].add(val);
        total_sum[level] += val;
        Count1++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generate_values(level + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static boolean is_valid(long x) {
        final long limit = 1000000L;
        return x * limit + 999999L <= n_value && x * limit * 10 > n_value;
    }

    static void explore(int level, long number) {
        if (number > n_value) return;
        if (is_valid(number)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long current = ((Count2 + 1 - (number * power_ten[i]) % Mod1) + Mod1) % Mod1;
                int position = lowerBound(values[i], Mod1 - current);
                long size = values[i].size();
                answer = (answer + total_sum[i] + current * size - Mod2 * (size - position)) % Mod2;
            }
            Count2 += Count1;
        } else {
            Count2++;
            answer = (answer + ((Count2 - number) % Mod1 + Mod1) % Mod1) % Mod2;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                explore(level + 1, number * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) high = mid;
            else low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        n_value = IO.ReadInt();
        generate_values(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(values[i]);
        }
        Count2 = -1;
        explore(0, 0);
        IO.WriteLong(answer);
    }
}
